description: Generate character names from real-world cultures — Western, East Asian, South Asian, Middle Eastern, African, Latin — plus a fantasy toggle.

faqs.a: Western, East Asian, South Asian, Middle Eastern, African, and Latin — each with authentic-style first and last name banks.
It swaps the cultural banks for original fantasy syllables to name elves, mages, and warriors.
faqs.q: What does the fantasy toggle do?

faqs.a: Click any name or its Copy button to copy it instantly.
faqs.q: How do I copy a name?

howto: Choose how many names to generate.
Press Generate, then click any name to copy it.
title: Character Name Generator
